conflicts.resolution: Use dated approximate metadata budgets; reject older universal 200K/550-field and deterministic precedence claims.
Native non-production deferral is documented; clones are optional and production fallback must be disclosed.
Do not automatically move every Query View or calculation upstream; preserve explicit placement choices.
Suggested repository layouts do not remove the stated extension Git limitation; qualify the selected route.
Do not invent primary keys or force aggregate_type onto every SQL-derived measure from a generic vendor prompt.
External edits are discouraged, not universally impossible; followers are specifically read-only.

access.description: Offline nonweakening and supplied exact-state/persona comparisons; not enforcement.

ai.description: Version2 approved direct/derived gold lineage and repeated offline answer/result comparisons; no native AI provenance.

checker.description: Bounded omni-static-v2-2026-10-05 core/query static contract; local synthetic tests, no native acceptance.

generator.description: Explicit reviewed physical, inherited and query mappings; synthetic candidate generation tests.

handoff.description: Curated exact-candidate semantic handoff rebuilt before export; no warehouse-layer or native acceptance claims.

inventory.description: Exact-byte native inventory, origin/dependency graph and hash-bound leaf patches; incomplete/opaque semantics stay explicit.

lifecycle.description: Changed/dependent closure and imported issue/environment preflight; independent lanes, no authenticated collector.

modeler.description: Pinned presanitized task callback and installation comparison; no SDK adapter or external-host qualification.

native.description: Signed isolated synthetic-development adapter with optional lifecycle binding; simulated transport tests only.

queries.description: Bounded modeled/read-only SQL query output and population lineage; local independent comparisons, no native compiler.

access.claim: Access grants, attributes and filters require effective-policy evaluation.

ai_context.claim: ai_context_patch is server-managed and model inheritance affects effective context.

ai_optimization.claim: Context has metadata budgets and nondeterministic behavior; no universal field-count limit.

ai_quality.claim: Model curation and independent real-question evaluation affect answer quality.

cache.claim: Cache age, scheduling and suggestions have separate behavior.

composite_topics.claim: Composite topics preserve separate fact grains through shared dimensions.

dbt_environments.claim: Native deferral is documented for non-production environments.

extensions.claim: Extensions inherit and can override parent logic.
extensions.release_status: full Git support for extension models: work in progress

filtered_measures.claim: Measure-local filters preserve separate aggregate populations.

follower.claim: Followers are read-only and promoted from a leader branch through PR.

git_practices.claim: Stale Omni branch promotion can overwrite newer shared content.

layers.claim: Schema, shared, workbook and branch scopes differ.

lod.claim: LOD changes aggregation grain and dimensionality.

model_settings.claim: Model parameters span operational and semantic settings; model skills is scheduled to be deprecated.

placement.claim: LOD, SQL, CTE and workbook calculations have context-dependent uses.

query_parameter.claim: Modeled query views expose selected and aliased output fields.

query_views.claim: Query Views use .query.view with modeled query or SQL definitions.

relationships.claim: Global and topic relationships and inferred cardinality differ.

role_playing.claim: Repeated table roles require scoped aliases.

sql_parameter.claim: SQL-backed views bind their projected output columns.

symmetric_aggregates.claim: Fanout protection depends on correct keys and relationship cardinality.

topics.claim: Topics curate business use cases over a base view and joins.

virtual_schemas.claim: Partial builds may resolve unbuilt models to production; migration has distinct operational steps.

ai_optimizer.purpose: AI curation guidance; no guaranteed precedence, accuracy or security enforcement.

builder.purpose: Modeling examples; review syntax and semantics against current docs and native contract.

explorer.purpose: Inventory guidance; not completeness, authorization or sandbox proof.

modeler.purpose: Role guidance; DMA authority and evidence controls remain authoritative.
